QuestInfo.name: Do You Know the Black Mage?
QuestInfo.0: If you've finished exchanging pleasantries with #p1101000#, it's time to meet #p1101000#'s tactician, #b#p1101002##k, and ask about your immediate duties.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# said you weren't strong enough to fight for Maple World, let alone appoint you as a Knight-in-Training. He said you must undergo a training course that has been prepared for you.  Let's go see #p1102000#, the training instructor.
